axis_notes.basis: Visual basis is the complete ordered image sequence of 65 pages, frames 0 to 1931. No direct playback and no direct listening. axis_notes.hook: Water rises across the yard from 0.8 s and caption starts at about 0.6 s. The phone alert lands late, at 5.6 s.
axis_notes.story: Dated actor and application (UT San Antonio, September 8th in credits), honest limit (no field result, no named town), stamp turn at 50.4 s, and a simple ending.
axis_notes.picture: Most clauses are depicted. Defects: the 18.4 to 19.6 s sensor labels contradict the optical-sensor clause, a floating arm at 53.2 to 54.2 s, the operator's eyes are closed 35.4 to 36.8 s, an empty gauge wait 40.9 to 42.5 s, 98.82% shown about 2 s before it is spoken with a fully filled bar, and a detached station inset with rings moving away from the hub.
axis_notes.place: The board declares Bexar, blackland, place plate blackland-san-antonio, and the county marker is disclosed as editorial. The source names no installation site. Not verified by me with place_check, and the skyline is generic.
axis_notes.craft: Clipped 'Flash Floo' on the phone 5.6 to 8.6 s, 'Field result' card cropped 48.0 to 49.8 s, 'Deployment plan' occluded 55.6 s, label over the station 57.2 to 59.4 s, static holds, about 7 s without voice, credits about 4.97 s (just under the 5 s hard-fail line).
axis_notes.voice: Provisional only. No listening. The provider asserts a clear, balanced mix, but loudness, true peak and the music tail were not measured by me. Caption on/off in frames matches the provider clause windows within about 0.2 s, but force-alignment on the final mix is unverified.
axis_notes.provider_check: The provider response (pass:true, defects:[]) is contradicted by frames on three points. Legibility is not unobstructed, because of the clipped phone text and cropped card. Visual changes are not continuous every two to three seconds, because of the static holds listed under pace. Its n3a window of 15.9 to 19.14 includes non-optical sensor labels from 18.4 s.

hard_fails_note: None established. Caption-timing and audio-stretch fails are unproven either way from images. Held slide over five seconds: no, the credits are 4.97 s. clauses.observed: Some people could have ankle-deep water in their yard. Water climbs the post and boots.
UT San Antonio says the phone warning can come after that. Dark phone, then alert at 5.6 s. Hard cut at 4.0 s, not a pan. 'Flash Floo' clipped.
So its researchers built a flood station. Pole with solar panel and Prototype flood station label.
It charges itself from light and needs no cell tower. Beam fills the battery bar, dashed cut line to the tower.

Four optical sensors at different heights watch the water. Correct to about 18.3 s. From 18.4 to 19.6 the picture shows Rain, Temperature, Humidity and Light sensors, not the optical water-level sensors, which contradicts the clause.
A small chip on the station runs the AI itself. TinyML board cutaway, but chip action starts only at 21.8 s after a 1.8 s static hold.
So it judges flood risk without a central server. Risk meter climbs, beacon lights, dashed unconnected link to the server.
Its radio signal can carry more than a half-mile in streets. Rings down a flooded street; the half-mile bar sits mid-street and is not tied to the station.
In open country, up to five miles, to a hub. Weak: rings expand from a floating station inset away from the hub; hub pings at 33.2 s; static from 33.4 s.
At the hub, a second, larger AI maps flood paths for responders. Operator eyes closed 35.4-36.8; route dots and orange flood paths 36.2-39.8.
The university reports early chip AI validation. Bulletin board arrives 40.9 s; gauge empty until 42.5 s, a dead wait; gauge fills 42.6-43.4.
Accuracy was ninety eight point eight two percent. The 98.82% figure was already shown at 43.2 s, about 2 s before it is spoken, and the bar reads fully filled.
The announcement reports no field result. Blank card, stamp lands None reported at 50.4-50.6 s.
It names no town with an installed station. Blank map labelled Not a real report or map; a disembodied floating arm points at it 53.2-54.2 s.
Deployment is still the goal. Figure packs the deployment plan; the Deployment goal label covers the station 57.2-59.4 s.
